translations.web: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
translations.bsb: One of you will say to me, “Then why does God still find fault? For who can resist His will?”
translations.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
translations.asv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he still find fault? For who withstandeth his will?
